messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the consolidated scope for the enterprise compliance work that touches audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2/ISO evidence, and retention buckets. I put a risk-first proposal below, want final gating criteria today if possible.

ankur: +1 on risk-first. Quick clarifying q: are we treating export formats (compact vs full) as a separate launch gate or part of 'audit export' deliverable?

sasha: proposing we keep export format as a follow-on (MVP: CSV + JSONL export). Advanced formats (parquet, signed bundles) go post-MVP.

maria: Agree with Sasha. MVP gates I care about: 1) Search SLO for audit queries (95p95 < 500ms for recent window), 2) Per-tenant retention configuration (TTL buckets), 3) BYOK onboarding handshake + KMS integration test, 4) Evidence packaging for SOC2 (packaging + hashing + signer), 5) Legal signoff on retention policy. Anything else?

devon: Ops note — BYOK handshake must include a KMS-escrow/rotation path. We need an explicit runbook for key revocation and emergency export. Otherwise oncall will veto.

kate (legal): We need retention tiers documented with retention justification for each tier (30/90/365/indef). Also need a legal hold escape hatch process in the runbook.

ankur: Implementation constraints: per-tenant TTLs exist in prototype but we need indexing updates for query performance. If we enable long-term cold archives, search SLO won't hit for cold data — propose SLO scoped to 'hot window' (last 90d).

maria: Good call — SLO scope = hot window (90d). Cold archive findability is "best effort" with an async export. Documenting that is a gating criteria.

sasha: For BYOK: current plan = support AWS KMS + GCP KMS for MVP. HSM/TLS key signing later. We need an integration test matrix and an SDK handshake sample: ```curl -X POST /v1/keys/handshake -d '{"key_uri":"aws-kms://arn:...","tenant":"acme"}'```

devon: Ops-bot, can we schedule canary for KYM+BYOK next week?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window for kms-handshake integration scheduled: 2026-05-04 02:00 UTC -> 2026-05-07 02:00 UTC. Notifications to oncall and security configured. :white_check_mark:

maria: Decision proposal (please ack): Gate 1 (must before public launch): A) Search SLO defined & measured for 90d hot window, B) Per-tenant TTL UI + API, C) BYOK handshake + successful integration tests for AWS+GCP, D) SOC2 evidence packaging with hashing + manifest, E) Legal retention matrix + hold process documented. Gate 2 (post-launch): cold-archive export formats, parquet signing, HSM/KMS-escrow automation.

ankur: ACK from infra side assuming 95p95 < 500ms in benchmark runs. Will post perf numbers by EOD.

sasha: ACK — will ship SDK sample and integration tests.

devon: ACK but will raise stop if escrow runbook incomplete. I'll draft runbook in ops-runbooks repo and ping here.

kate (legal): ACK with one ask: include schema for evidence metadata (who accessed, chain-of-custody) before launch.

maria: Great — action items: @ankur post perf bench by EOD (3960001300), @sasha open PR with SDK + tests (3960001350), @devon create escrow runbook draft (3960001400), @kate upload retention matrix doc (3960001420). If all ACK by EOD we lock scope and schedule canary.

ankur: On it.

sasha: PR incoming.

devon: Draft created, will ping.

maria: Thanks everyone. If no objections by EOD we move this into the roadmap and mark launch criteria as 'Gate 1 required' in the spreadsheet. :rocket:
